Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to make award in respect of plot No. 326 which was acquired by the State-respondents under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Case of the petitioners is that they have been served with a notice dated 01.08.2022 by respondent No. 2 calling them to file objections as per the provisions of Section 21 of the Act.

The Surendra Singh And Another vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 12 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153270903/
1 petitioners allege that they had duly filed objections on receipt of the said notice.

entities.text: Surendra Singh And Another vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, no award has been made till date.
3. Under the Scheme of the Act, the Collector after issuing notice under Section 21 is required to hold enquiry and thereafter make award as per Section 23.
4. Therefore, it is statutory duty of the second respondent to make award failing which consequences as provided under the Act would ensue.
Chief Standing Counsel states that if award has not yet been made, it will be made expeditiously.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of by providing that in case award has not yet been made, the Collector will ensure that the enquiry is completed expeditiously followed by an award.
The petitioners will file true attested copy of the instant order before the Collector within two weeks so that he may proceed in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 12.9.2023 Mukesh Kr.
(Donadi Ramesh,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
